**This section is a collection of the resources I've found helpful during my undegrad studies (and later package development).** As a Statistics major in the Philippines, people would jokingly call us *"endangered species"* due to the traditionally low number of enrollees. This made academic support extra challenging due to the low number of people who understands my concern. So I searched stuff online and found these; I think these are helpful if you also:

* *1. HATES proving theorems and find applied statistics more enjoyable;*
* *2. Comes from a developing nation who doesn't have all the time to learn huge books due to poor internet connection, frequent power outage, etc and;*
* *3. Is frustrated because the software keeps crashing and doesnt understand your research so you are considering making your own package for valid inference.*

If you have other questions about my experience as a Statistics student, being a maintainer of packages, CRAN submissions, and literally anything that would convince you to take Stat, just email me at **ninotalingting77@gmail.com**. **Don't forget to test your assumptions and map your residuals!**
